caption: No mask: DeepTumorVQA's own image, as released for its questions. DeepTumorVQA benchmark scan BDMAP_00000162 (KiTS21_img0205 by DeepTumorVQA's ID mapping). Its benchmark questions ask whether the kidney has tumours (answer: Yes) and where the largest one is (answer: left). The metadata lists three kidney tumours with a total volume of 15.3 cm³; its recorded largest-tumour diameter, 16.1 cm, is one of the values affected by the diameter defect described in the quality findings. Five axial slices spread across the kidneys, side by side, exactly as DeepTumorVQA releases the image for its questions; per the paper they use a window of -150 to 250 HU. No outline is drawn.
